pages.text: Unusual Dust is not mere residue left behind by a spell. It is the crowning work of the Sorcerer's own black art, a study no other Illager has ever replicated. He bound his soul to the dust itself, so that even in death he might return.

A petty noble among the Illagers, he marched alongside the raiding parties, and a Vindicator attended him as his personal guard. Now his soul is bound to the dust once more, and serves you in the same manner.

Like other bound illagers, it floats above the ground, unaffected by gravity. Despite its spirit-like appearance, it cannot phase through walls and can still be harmed by conventional weaponry. The bound soul can be healed by right-clicking on it with Ectoplasm.
